confirmed_in_window_story.why_in_window: NVIDIA’s GTC Berlin feed lists Minerva at Thursday, Oct. 22, 8:00 am PDT. Converting the explicitly stated PDT (UTC−07:00) gives 2026-10-22T15:00:00Z / 2026-10-23T00:00:00+09:00. This is the feed listing time, not availability. confirmed_in_window_story.not_a_model_release: Minerva is an AI-factory observability/AIOps platform, not a new foundation model release.
confirmed_in_window_story.business_relevance: Correlates telemetry across infrastructure and AI workloads, adds anomaly/root-cause investigation and agent-assisted workflows. The vendor’s operational-benefit statements are not independently measured in this research.
confirmed_in_window_story.deployment_pricing_caveat: Official product page describes on-premises and SaaS deployment and multiple consumption models. The US page directs visitors to regional sites for pricing and availability; no price was listed on the checked US page.
confirmed_in_window_story.vendor_reported_adoption: NVIDIA says IREN is using Minerva and lists other companies as planning deployments; treated as vendor reporting, not independent verification.

items.title: Cosmos: Open, Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
items.publisher_page_time_or_timezone: not stated
items.notes: Official article date is Oct 21, 2026; no time or timezone is stated on the article. Describes five cloud-native Cosmos Data Factory blueprints through GitHub, Microsoft Azure, Nebius, and CoreWeave; Cosmos Framework skills extending training, optimization, and deployment workflows to more open models including GR00T, Alpamayo, Qwen, and Pi0.5; Cosmos 3 Nano simulation variants; updated Cosmos 3 NIM and Metropolis VSS 3.3. This is tooling/workflow expansion, not a new base-model weight release. The article does not state new model API IDs, prices, or regions. Vendor performance claims were not independently benchmarked.
